author: mostafa_gawad / JUMP ANIMATION
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements:
* Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate.
* Ability to match an established cartoon art style.
* Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to:
* jobs@jumpanimation.com
* gawad26@gmail.com

💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook!

If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: The Dzinrz Illustration Studio
title: Hiring Illustrators for Children's Books and Character Design
content:
WE’RE HIRING ILLUSTRATORS!

Are you a skilled illustrator with a passion for creativity and storytelling? We’d love to see your work!

At The Dzinrz Illustration Studio, we bring stories to life through children’s book illustrations, character design, and a variety of creative projects.

Who can apply?
Anyone with strong illustration skills, creativity, and a passion for creating engaging artwork is welcome to apply. We value talent, creativity, and the willingness to grow!

📍 Location: Applicants from Gujrat, Pakistan, will be given priority. Remote work opportunities are also available for talented artists from other locations.

📩 How to apply:
Send your portfolio or work samples to hello@thedzinrz.com

🌐 Visit www.thedzinrz.com to explore our portfolio and get a better understanding of the projects we work on.

Know someone who loves illustration? Tag them or share this opportunity!

author: atosasofficial / A Tale of Stars & Shadows
title: Looking for Background Artists for Indie Animatic Series
content:
Hey everyone! We’re looking for BACKGROUND ARTISTS to join our indie fantasy animatic series, A Tale of Stars & Shadows! ✨

If you love fantasy, mystery, and bringing magical worlds to life, we’d love to hear from you! Our pilot is already out, and we’re looking for artists to help us bring the next chapter of this passion project to life.

Send your portfolios to our email (last slide) or in our DMs!

Applications will stay open indefinitely 🫶

Please note that this is initially an unpaid opportunity. We’ve yet to receive any revenue from the project, but we’re working towards a Kickstarter as development progresses. If the project generates revenue, profits will be shared fairly among all contributors!
